# AWS Well-Architected

Evidence-backed AWS Well-Architected Framework reviews across all six pillars on the main agent, with AWS Knowledge and the Well-Architected security MCP server.

## How it works

This is a **vertical plugin**: its skills, commands, and MCP servers attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off. Prefer the [`aws-solutions-architect`](../../agent-plugins/aws-solutions-architect) agent plugin when you want an isolated specialist instead.

- Install: `claude plugin install aws-well-architected@talkops-devops-plugins`
- Skills activate from their descriptions; invoke one explicitly with `/aws-well-architected:<skill>`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `aws-well-architected-review` | Performs a full AWS Well-Architected Framework review evaluating every framework question across all pillars discovered from the live AWS documentation by analyzing code, IaC, and configurations to produce evidence-back… |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-well-architected:review` | Run an evidence-backed Well-Architected review |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json); started when the plugin is enabled and available to the main agent.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Tool names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-mcp` | stdio | `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli==1.7.0` `--skip-auth --metadata` | `mcp__plugin_aws-well-architected_aws-mcp__*` | Managed AWS MCP Server via the toolkit's pinned proxy (aws___call_aws, aws___search_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, ...). |
| `awsknowledge` | http | `https://knowledge-mcp.global.api.aws` | `mcp__plugin_aws-well-architected_awsknowledge__*` |  |
| `wa-security` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.well-architected-security-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-well-architected_wa-security__*` |  |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
